_comment: Per-model prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Fill in `input` and `output` for
each model you evaluate; until both are set, the harness reports token counts
but shows cost as '—' for that model.
`cachedInput` and `cacheWrite` are OPTIONAL. Leave them null to bill those
tokens at the plain `input` rate. Setting them makes cost accounting accurate
when prompt caching kicks in, which it does here because every trial resends
Lookup is keyed on the model OpenAI reports actually serving the request
(often a dated snapshot such as 'gpt-5.4-2026-03-17'), then falls back to the
requested name, then to the longest matching prefix key below.
